data.narrative:
Vermeer is a Series A-stage defense and security company that has raised $10M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 11 same-sector and adjacent-stage companies, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Singularity.

Two triangulation methods apply here. Stage-progression analysis uses the $10M raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, implying a $20M valuation. Peer-median analysis across 11 defense and security companies at series B and adjacent stages yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $3.0B. The peer set includes Dream Security at $3.0B, Allen Control Systems at $2.2B, and Harmattan AI at $1.4B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $17M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $510M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty about Vermeer's competitive positioning and growth trajectory relative to the peer universe. Stage-progression implies a conservative floor, while peer median anchors a midpoint assumption. Key risks to valuation include execution on product roadmap, customer acquisition in a concentrated buyer pool, and whether Vermeer can command multiples comparable to later-stage peers or will compress toward earlier-stage private company valuations pending further proof points.
